svg.title: DevSecOps pipeline for a Node.js application deployed to AKS, with quality and security gates.
svg.desc: A GitHub push fires a webhook that starts a Jenkins pipeline of nine steps and five gates: checkout, build and test, test gate, SonarQube analysis, quality gate, Trivy filesystem scan, dependency gate, Docker build, Trivy image scan, image security gate, push to ACR, Helm deploy, deployment gate, verify. Below, the Azure Cloud zone shows the Jenkins VM, SonarQube server, Azure Container Registry, and an AKS cluster containing the NGINX ingress controller, service, application deployment pods, and workload configuration, fronted by an Azure Load Balancer that users reach over HTTPS.
svg.text: DEVSECOPS PIPELINE FOR NODE.JS APPLICATION DEPLOYMENT TO AKS
JENKINS PIPELINE (declarative, running on the Ubuntu Jenkins VM)
JENKINS CREDENTIALS (Credentials Manager — nothing hardcoded in the Jenkinsfile)
INSTALLED ON THE JENKINS VM (tools, not credentials)
starts the pipeline on every push to main
Without the second one, GATE 2 hangs until timeout.
cluster aks-car-marketplace · namespace car-marketplace · metrics-server enabled
• Runs as pods inside the cluster
helm upgrade --install --atomic then kubectl verify + helm test (kubeconfig from az aks get-credentials)
Which pipeline stage acts on this resource
• The pipeline halts at the first failing gate — no image is built, pushed or deployed after a failure.
• Images are tagged <BUILD_NUMBER>-<GIT_SHA>, which is what makes helm upgrade produce a new pod spec.
• Trivy gates run --ignore-unfixed and block on CRITICAL while reporting HIGH+, so unfixable base-image
CVEs cannot deadlock the build. Accepted CVEs are listed in .trivyignore with a review date.
• helm upgrade --atomic --wait automatically rolls back a failed rollout; helm history keeps 10 revisions.
• The NGINX ingress controller and the application both run as pods inside AKS — not beside it.
• SonarQube runs as a container on the Jenkins VM and must call back to /sonarqube-webhook/.
Fully automated CI/CD on every push
Code quality enforced by a Quality Gate
Only approved images ever reach ACR
Infrastructure as code with a Helm chart
Zero secrets stored in the repository
